title: Last Holiday
about: A shy shop assistant told she has weeks to live blows her savings on a luxury holiday in a grand European hotel.
cue: Serve the main when Georgia says "Tout, baby!" and orders it all.

    StartersGeorgia's Joint crab cakes, lemon aioliPanko crumbed crab cakes with spring onion and lemon aioliHow to make it400g crab meat7 tbsp mayonnaise1 egg2 spring onions1 lemon1 tsp Dijon mustard120g panko breadcrumbs3 tbsp vegetable oil1 garlic clove50g rocket1 bunch of parsleyMix the crab with mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, Dijon and panko.Shape into small cakes.Chill for 30 minutes.Roll in more panko.Fry in oil over medium heat until golden each side.Mix the mayonnaise with crushed garlic and lemon juice.Serve with the aioli and a few dressed rocket and parsley leaves.Karlovy Vary mushroom and gruyère tartsMushroom and gruyère puff squares fit for a New Year's Eve feastHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry300g mixed mushrooms30g butter2 garlic cloves1 bunch of thyme100g gruyère1 egg1 bottle of truffle oilCut the pastry into squares, score a border on each and prick the middle.Fry the mushrooms in butter with garlic and thyme until golden.Spoon onto the pastry centres and top with grated gruyère.Brush the borders with egg.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Drizzle with a few drops of truffle oil.Seared foie gras on briocheGeorgia cooked it for the neighbour. Didier never repeats a menu.How to make it4 duck breasts800g potatoes3 oranges2 tbsp honey30ml orange liqueur200ml chicken stock20g butter300g green beansScore the duck skin and season.Place skin-side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat to render the fat.Flip and roast at 200°C.Rest the duck.Fry the par-boiled potatoes in some of the duck fat until crisp.Pour off the rest of the fat, add orange juice, honey, orange liqueur and stock and reduce until glossy.Whisk in the butter.Steam the green beans and serve alongside.Grandhotel Pupp beef goulashPaprika beef braised soft with buttered noodles, Czech comfort at the grand hotelHow to make it1kg beef chuck, in large cubes2 tbsp vegetable oil3 onions, sliced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp caraway seeds2 tbsp tomato paste750ml beef stock300g wide egg noodles30g butter150g sour creamBrown the beef in the oil in batches. Lift out.Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft and golden, then add the garlic, paprika, caraway and tomato paste.Return the beef, add the stock, cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart.Boil the noodles, toss with the butter and serve under the goulash with sour cream.SweetsDessert trolley chocolate mousseRich dark chocolate mousse with whipped creamHow to make it200g dark chocolate30g butter3 eggs300ml thickened cream40g caster sugar125g raspberries4 thin wafer biscuitsMelt the chocolate with butter and cool slightly.Whisk in the egg yolks one at a time.Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in.Whisk the egg whites with sugar to soft peaks and fold through gently in two batches.Spoon into glasses.Chill for 3 hours.Top with whipped cream, raspberries and a thin wafer biscuit.DrinksGrandhotel champagne cocktailSugar cube, bitters, brandy and champagne for a roulette winHow to make it4 sugar cubes1 bottle of aromatic bitters60ml brandy750ml champagne1 orange750ml sparkling apple juicePlace a sugar cube in each flute and soak with bitters.Add brandy to each glass.Slowly top with chilled champagne or sparkling wine.Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.Slivovitz plum brandyGeorgia snowboards, tries BASE jumping, then this by the fire.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
